newsitem.title: RUSSIA: City of Moscow to issue $400 mln 3-year Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: City of Moscow to issue $400 mln 3-year Eurobond.

text.p: The City of Moscow has registered a $400 million three-year Eurobond with the Russian Finance Ministry, a source in the Moscow government said on Tuesday.
"We have registered a prospectus for $400 million for three years," the source said.
Previously, Western bankers had said the volume of the issue would be between $400 to $500 million for three to five years.
The City of Moscow will hold a road-show for its debut Eurobond May 11-23 in the United States, Europe and Asia, the source told Reuters.
The delegation will be divided into two groups, he said.
The first group, headed by First Deputy Mayor Oleg Tolkachev will work in Asia and the United States, he said.

Moscow Mayor Yuri Luzhkov is scheduled to join the road-show on May 21-23 in New York. The head of the municipal borrowing department of the Moscow government, Mechislav Klimovich, will attend the road-show in New York on May 19-20 and 21-23 and in Boston on May 20-21, the source said.
The second group, headed by First Deputy Mayor Valery Shantsev, will work in Europe.
Klimovich will also attend the road-show in Europe.
